how_to_apply: Candidates can apply for DHS Cuddalore Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below.
Visit the official website: cuddalore.nic.in and complete the online registration for the relevant post.
Take a printout of the filled application form.

Attach self-attested copies of the required documents: SSLC certificate, HSC certificate, educational qualification certificate relevant to the post, mark sheets, community certificate, residence (nativity) certificate, and, where applicable, certificate for differently abled candidates / widow / divorced person / third gender.

Submit the completed application with document copies in person, or send it by Speed Post, to: Member Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, District Health Office, 05 Beach Road, Cuddalore - 607001.
Ensure the application reaches the office between 22.08.2026, 10:00 AM and 09.09.2026, 5:00 PM. Applications received after this deadline will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: DHS Cuddalore Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The District Collector of Cuddalore, Thiru C. Aditya Senthil Kumar I.A.S., has announced that the District Health Society (Cuddalore), functioning under the National Health Mission scheme, invites applications from eligible candidates for various temporary contract posts. Below is a quick overview of the recruitment. Register for Job Alerts

rows.details: District Health Society, Cuddalore (DHS Cuddalore) - under National Health Mission

15 categories (Medical Officer, ANM, RBSK Pharmacist, Lab Technician, ICTC Lab Technician, ICTC Counselor, Mid Level Health Provider, Public Health Inspector Grade II, Homeopathy Medical Officer, Yoga Trainer, Pharmacist, Siddha Medical Officer, Medicine Dispenser, Therapeutic Assistant, Dental Surgeon)
Purely temporary/contract basis; not permanent at any time; service can be terminated at any time
Online registration at cuddalore.nic.in, followed by submission of the filled application with documents in person or by Speed Post

content_sections.heading: DHS Cuddalore Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications received after the closing date and time will not be accepted. The notification does not specify a separate window for online registration versus offline submission - both fall within the same period stated above.

content_sections.heading: DHS Cuddalore Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 54 vacancies are available across 15 posts. Vacancy numbers are subject to change, as stated by the District Collector.

content_sections.heading: DHS Cuddalore Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria & Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility differs by post. Candidates should check the specific qualification and age limit for the post they wish to apply for. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is CDHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the District Health Society, Cuddalore (functioning under the National Health Mission) to fill 54 temporary contract posts across 15 categories such as Medical Officer, ANM, Lab Technician, Public Health Inspector Grade II, and others.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 54 vacancies are available across 15 posts. The largest number is for Public Health Inspector Grade II, with 31 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 09.09.2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements differ for each post, ranging from SSLC/HSC-based diploma courses to MBBS and BDS degrees. See the Eligibility section above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit varies by post, ranging from below 35 years to below 59 years. See the Eligibility section above for exact limits per post.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates need to register online at cuddalore.nic.in, print the filled application, attach the required documents, and submit it in person or via Speed Post to the District Health Office, Cuddalore, within the application window.
